_how_to: Copy to resume.json and replace everything with your real details. headlines, summaries and cover_letter.tracks are keyed by track (agile, transformation, ai, default). Tag skills and bullets with the tracks they prove. Write aliases the way you want them printed: when a posting uses an alias instead of the skill name, the resume shows the posting's wording. A skill with only_if_asked is listed only when the posting asks for it. A bullet can carry your own alternative wording per track under by_track. Under versions, each regional version overrides the base resume: give only what differs (a different phone under contact, a personal details line, a different summary; lists such as experience are replaced whole); which countries get which version is set in config.json > resume_versions. The app only selects, reorders and relabels what you write here; it never invents experience.
